name: Grilled Steak & Vegetables with Chimichurri Sauce

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash zucchini, bell peppers, and carrots. Slice zucchini diagonally into rounds. Seed and cut peppers into 8 strips. Peel, halve crosswise, then halve or quarter carrots lengthwise.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers
6 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Transfer vegetables to a large bowl. Drizzle with oil and season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add vegetables to grill/skillet and cook until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side.

Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together parsley, garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 cloves garlic
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper
3 pinches crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place steak and vegetables on a plate and drizzle with chimichurri sauce. Enjoy!
